description: Common rafter length, ridge rise and roof angle from the horizontal run and pitch, with optional overhang. Formula: Pitch factor = √(1 + (rise/12)²). Rafter length = (run + overhang) × pitch factor. Ridge rise = run × rise ÷ 12. Angle = atan(rise ÷ 12).

pitch_rise.description: Pitch (rise per 12 in of run) (in); default 6

run_ft.description: Horizontal run (half the span, minus half the ridge board) (ft); default 14

name: calc_rafter_length
title: Rafter Length Calculator (From Run and Roof Pitch)
